content: Jesu Ana Morob Isan Baban Hio.
Faraw Wanawanan Yeast en ana hiyuw wabin Tar Nowaten aa isan ana veya i na kabom.
Naatu nati ana veya’amaim firis ukwarih naatu Ofafar Bai’obaiyenayah wa’iwa’iramaim ef hinunuwet mi’itube Jesu hitab hitarab tamorob isan, anayabin bebeyanamaim sinafumih sabuw hibiruwih.
Judas Ibasit Jesu Morob Isan Baban Eo
Nati ana veya’amaim, Jesu ana bai’ufununayah 12 wanawanahimaim orot Judas wabin ta Iscariot Satan dogoron wanawanan run.
Basit na firis ukwarih naatu Tafaror Bar ma’utenayah hai orot ukwarih biyah tit, Jesu mi’itube nab nabitih isan bairi hiyakitifuw.
Naatu orot ukwarih hiyasisir Judas kabay baitinin isan hio’matan.
Judas ibasit naatu ef ana gewasin wa’iwa’iramaim nuwet, mi’itube Jesu tab tabitih, sabuw men hitaso’ob.
Jesu Ana Bay Aafufun
Faraw Wanawanan Yeast en hiyuw ana veya natit, nati ana veya’amaim i Tar Nowaten isan sheep natunatuh lamb terouw sibor teya’aya.
Imih Peter, John hairi Jesu eobaimanih iyafarih eo, “Kwanan Tar Nowaten ana hiyuw kwanabogaigiwas tanaa.”
Hibatiy hio, “Menamaim kukokok boro ana bogaigiwas?”
Jesu iyafutih eo, “Kwanan Jerusalem kwanatitit auman orot ta boro noukwatamaim harew nahun na’abar nanan bairi kwanitar, naatu kwani’ufunun bairi kwanan bar erurumaim kwanarun.
Naatu bar matuwan orot kwanibatiy, ‘Bai’obaiyenayan,’ o isa iti na’atube eo. ‘Ayu au bai’ufununayah bairi nanawan bar awan menatan boro imaim Tar Nowaten ana bay anaa?’
Naatu i boro bar awan gagamin yate tafan ni’obaiyi kwana’itin, nati’imaim sawar etei hirereb hiyabuna inu’in, imaim kwanabogaigiwas.”
Orot rou’ab hitit hinan sawar etei Jesu eo na’atube hi’itah, basit Tar Nowaten hiyuw hibogaigiwas.
Bay aa isan ana veya tit, naatu Jesu ana tur abarayah bairi bay aa ana efanamaim himare.
Baise iuwih eo, “Ayu akokok kwanekwan iti Tar Nowaten ana bay kwa bairit tanaa, imaibo ani’akir biyau nababan.
Anayabin a tur ao’owen, ayu i boro men kafa’imo iti bay anaa maiye, ana veya’amaim iti sawar yabin anababatun niturobe God ana aiwob wanawananamaim.”
Imaibo Jesu kerowas bai, God ana merar yi, naatu ana bai’ufununayah itih eo, “Kerowas iti kwabai etei’imak kwafaram kwatom.
A tur ao’owen, veya iti boun ebubusuruf ayu iti wine boro men anatom, ayu boro iti na’atube ana ma nan God ana aiwob nan natit.”
Naatu rafiy bai God ana merar yi sawar, imasib ana bai’ufununayah itih eo, “Iti i ayu biyou, kwa abit, iti na’atube kwanasinaf saise imaim ayu kwananuhu.”
Naatu kerowas isan i na’atube sinaf, bay hi’aa ufunamaim bai itih eo. “Iti kerowas i God ana Obaibasit Boubun ayu au rara’amaim ibour kwa etei isa ebisuwai.
Baise kwanaso’ob orot yait ayu morobomih babau eo, i iti gemamaim airi ama’am.
Orot Natun i boro namorob God isan yayakitifuw na’atube, baise orot yait baban eo emomorob i boro baimakiy gagamin na’in nab.”
Basit bai’ufununayah taiyuwi hibabatiyih hio, “Iti kou’ay wanawanamaim o yait iti na’atube sinafumih iyakitifuw ima kunotanot?”
Bai’ukwarin Isan Iigam
Bai’ufununayah taiyuwih wanawanahimaim gamin matar hai kokok hitaso’ob yait i orot gagamin.

Jesu iuwih eo, “Tafaram wanawanan Eteni Sabuw hai aiwob ana sabuw kaifih isan i hai fair ema’am imih sabuw tekakaifih, naatu sabuw iyab onowaten hibai sabuw tebobonawiyih, i tekokok wabih nara’at Bonawiyenayah hinarouw.
Baise kwa wanawanamaim i men na’atube nama, o yait orot gagamin mataramih taiyuw inayare inikek, naatu o yait bonawiyenayan mataramih taituwa isah ini’akir inabow.
Yait i orot gagamin, orot bay aayan o orot bay semorayan? Orot mare ma bay eaau i turobe orot gagamin. Baise ayu kwa wanawanamaim i akir wairafin na’atube ama kwa isa abowabow.
Au routobon fokarih wanawananamaim men kwaihamiyu, baise sisibu’umaim mar etei bairi tama’am.
Tamai aiwob ana fair itu abi’aiwob
na’atube nati fair ta’imon kwa abit kwani’aiwob
Kwa boro au aiwob wanawananamaim kwanaa, kwanatom yasisir kwanab, aiwob hai ura ma’ama’amaim kwanamare Israel sabuw hai big etei 12 kwanakaifih.”
Peter, Jesu Yaub
Jesu eo, “Simon, Simon! Satan i baibasit God biyanane bai, kwa routobon nit nakubaituturimih. Orot masaw bowayan ana rice erab erububunai ani’aanin nabin eyai, naatu kanabin nabin eya’iyai na’atube.
Baise Simon, ayu o isa ayoyoyoban, saise a baitumatum men nara’iy, naatu ayu isou inamamatabir ana veya, taituwa koufair initih hinabatkikin.”
Baise Peter iya’afut eo, “Regah ayu airit na dibur run naatu na morob isan abobuna ama’am.”
Jesu eo, “Peter, boun gugumin o boro mar tounu inayoub inao, ‘Ayu orot nati men aso’ob,’ i ufunamaim kokorere boro nao inanowar.”
Kaukut, Hafoy, Naatu Kaiy

Imaibo Jesu ana bai’ufununayah ibatiyih eo, “Kwanotanot ayu ai yuni aur kaukut, hafoy naatu a baibiyon en kwatit kwanan ana veya’amaim, sawar afa isah kwaiyababan.” Hiya’afut hio, “Men abistan ta isan ai yababanamih.”
Jesu iuwih eo, “Baise a tur ao’owen, o yait aur kaukut, o hafoy ema’am inab, naatu o yait aur kaiy en, a biya baibiyon inab inan hinatubun naatu kabay inab kaiy inatubun uma inisinfafar.
Anayabin a tur ao’owen, Buk Atamaninamaim iti na’atube hio hikirum, ‘Hi’i’itin i bainowan mowanabe,’ naatu nati tur i ayu isou hikirum, naatu boro anasinaf nan yabin namatar’’”
Bai’ufununayah hio, “Regah kaiy rou’ab iti abobotanen kui’itan.” Jesu iyafutih eo, “Nati ana fofonin.”
Jesu Olive Oyawemaim Yoyoban
Jesu ana bai’ufununayah bairi matan fufur tisisinaf na’atube Jerusalem hihamiy hiyen hin Olive Oyawemaim hitit.
Jesu na nati efanamaim titit ana veya, basit ana bai’ufununayan iuwih eo, “Kwanayoyoban saise routobon nanan boro kwanarukouw.”
Imaibo in fotafot wan ana fofonin na’atube, sun yowen yoyoban
eo, “Tamai inakokok na’at, basit iti biyababan ana kerowas biyau’umaim kubosair, men ayu au kok, baise abisa o kukokok na’atube namatar.”
Jesu dogoron wanawan yababan yan awan karatan, dogoron tutufin etei yoyoban ana foyab rara na’atube hituhorohoror me yan hire, naatu God ana tounamatar marane hire hina fair hitin.
Yoyoban sawar misir inan, ana bai’ufununayah matah fot hi’inu’in itih, hai yababan ra’at kwanekwan easbunih hi’inu’in.
Iuwih eo, “Aisim kwa’inu’in? Kwamisir kwayoyoban saise men routobon kwanab.”
Jesu Hibai Hifatum
Jesu iti na’atube bat eo auman, bai’ufununayah 12 wanawanahimaim orot ta wabin Judas sabuw rou’ay gagamin na’in nawiyih hina hitit. Naatu Judas mutufor in Jesu biyan tit bai mamay.
Baise Jesu iu, “Judas o iti mamayenamaim Orot Natun ibai rakit sabuw kubitih?”
Bai’ufununayah bairi hibatabat Jesu isan abisa mamatar hi’itin, basit hibatiy, “Regah karam boro kaiyomaim bairi aniyow?”
Naatu ana bai’ufununayah orot ta ana kaiy bora’ah, Firis Gagamin ana akir wairafin ta tainin asukwafune buru’um.
Baise Jesu eo, “Men inasinaf maiye kunutanub!” Naatu Jesu orot tainin butubun efanin matar maiye.

Imaibo Jesu firis ukwarih, Tafaror Bar ana firis ukwarin, furisiman, naatu regaregah ai’in Jesu bain fatuminamih hinan iuwih eo, “Kwa iti kaiy, kefat yuwu rabu’umih kwabow kwanan ana itinin i ayu orot kakafu bainowan na’atube?

Ayu mar etei Tafaror Bar gagamin wanawanan bairit tama’am, men kwakok boro imaim ayu kwatafatumu? Baise iti boun i kwa a veya, imih abisa kwakokok na’atube kwasinaf. Anayabin gugumin ana orot ebobonawiyi.”
Peter, Jesu Yaub
Jesu hibai hifatum hibai hin Firis Gagamin ana bar hitit, naatu Peter nabineika bat i’uf nunih bairi hin hitit.
Wairaf merar yan foun hi’asir himare hima rararih, Peter na wanawanah mare bairi hima rararih,
basit akir wairafin babitai ta nuw Peter ma wairaf rarar itin, naatu matan kubar itinbunai sawar imaibo eo, “Iti orot auman i Jesu hairi hima hireremor.”
Baise Peter yaub eo, “Babitai, ayu nati orot i men kafa’i aso’ob.”
Hima kafa’imo, orot ta itin maiye eo, “O i ni’i orot ana bai’ufununayan ta.” Baise Peter iya’afut eo, “Aro, ayu men nati orot ana bai’ufununayan ta’amih.”
Hima one hour na’atube sawar, basit orot tabo iban eo maiye “Tur anababatun iti orot i Galilee matuwan Jesu hairi hima hireremor men kasikasiy ta’amih.”
Baise Peter orot iya’afut eo, “Aro ayu men kafa’i aso’ob o abisa kuo.” Iti na’at eo auman kokorere eo.
Regah tatabir mutufor nuw Peter itin, naatu Regah abisa eo i not, “Boun gugumin o boro mar tounu ayu inayayoubu ufunamaim kokorere boro nao.”
Basit Peter misir tit in ufun re rerey i gagagamat.
Jesu Baiyowayah Hi’i’iyab
Orot afa Jesu hima’uh hima’am himisir faifuw ta hibai matan hisum,
imaibo hi’i’iyab naatu hiborabirab hio, “Kuo anowar, yait o rabi?”
Naatu tur kakafih moumurih maiyow hiu kwanikwaniy hi’i’iyab.
Jesu Kanisel Nahimaim Bat Hibatiy
Mar sibisib auman sabuw hai regaregah ai’in, firis ukwarih naatu Ofafar Bai’obaiyenayah etei hiru’ay hita’imon, imaibo Jesu hinawiy hina Kaniser nahimaim bat
naatu hibatiy, “Kuo anowar o i Keriso?” Jesu iyafutih eo, “A tur ana’owen boro men kwanitutumu’umih,
naatu ana bibatiyi auman boro men kwaniyafutu’umih.
Baise mar enan Orot Natun boro God fairin uman asukwafune namare nama’am kwana’itin.”
Naatu etei’imak hibatiy hio, “Bo o God Natun?” Jesu iyafutih eo, “Ayu God Natun kwarouw kwao i tur anababatun kwao.”
Imaibo sabuw hio, “Men takokok koubuna’ayah sabuw afa tanabow, anayabin tur awanamaim titit i tainitamaim tanowar!”
